title: Littleborough Christmas lights: Church Street restrictions confirmed for 28 November
excerpt: Church Street restrictions are planned for Littleborough's Christmas lights event on Saturday 28 November, including a daytime waiting ban and an afternoon road closure.
body:
Drivers and visitors heading into Littleborough for the Christmas lights event on Saturday, 28 November 2026 should plan around temporary restrictions on Church Street.

Rochdale Borough Council's published traffic notice says a road closure will operate from 1.30pm until 7pm. A prohibition on waiting is due to run from noon until 7pm on the same day, meaning parking arrangements will change before the road closure starts.

The notice identifies Church Street and Peel Street as the location of the restriction. Its wording for the precise starting junction is unclear, because it describes Church Street as beginning at a junction with Church Street itself. Residents who need access to a particular property should check the official notice and seek clarification from the council rather than relying on an assumed boundary.

The council lists Church Street, Morgan Street, Peel Street and Station Road as the alternative route. Drivers should follow temporary signs on the day, as the published notice does not provide a street-by-street map of how each turning will operate.

The restrictions are for the Littleborough Christmas Lights Event 2026, which the council has confirmed for Saturday, 28 November. The traffic notice does not give the entertainment timetable or the exact time of the lights switch-on, so those details should not be assumed from the road closure hours.

Anyone planning to visit shops, businesses or homes around the affected streets should allow extra time, particularly during the afternoon and early evening. Those with deliveries or access requirements may wish to confirm arrangements ahead of the event.

The full council notice, including the restriction wording and alternative route, can be checked at https://www.rochdale.gov.uk/directory-record/2626/littleborough-christmas-lights-event-2026-road-closures-in-littleborough-on-28-november-2026.

Are you organising a Littleborough Christmas event? Send the verified details to Rochdale Daily so residents can plan their visit.
